Name: Huwa's Sebastian portraits and sprites
Author: Mekehuwa
Description:
[size=4][b]This mod requires Portraiture (for HD portraits) and Content patcher (for the sprites)[/b][/size]
pretty sure the majority of people on nexus knows how to install a portrait mod that requires portraiture, but just incase there's still someone in need of instructions, i'll explain it

1. Download and install the mod "Portraiture" to your mods folder
2.Create a folder in "Mods/Portraiture/Portraits", [b]for me[/b] i named my folder "regulars". it'll be like this "Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/regulars"
3.Drag the portraits png files to your "regulars" folder
4.Run the game, talk to sebastian, when the dialogue box open press "P" and it will show the portrait. (your folder's name will pop up so u know its your folder)


[b]Portraiture's Hot keys:[/b]
"P" to change Portrait-Set when the DialogBox is open.
"I" to toggle between the larger portrait above the dialogue and the normal ones when the DialogBox is open.
"O" to fix or unfix a portrait-set selection of a specific NPC when their DialogBox is open, when fixed they will ignore further set changes and stay as they are
